rows.formula: (@death_ages.amr_share_under5 * @moral_weights.uov_per_death_under5 + @death_ages.amr_share_5_14 * @moral_weights.uov_per_death_age_5_14 + @death_ages.amr_share_15_49 * @moral_weights.uov_per_death_age_15_49 + @death_ages.amr_share_50plus * @moral_weights.uov_per_death_age_50_74) * $life_value_multiplier / $uov_per_daly
rows.explainer: Every death the site counts is valued by the age it happens at (docs/normalization.md, decision 2026-10-31 #4): GiveWell's moral weights by age over the ages of deaths from drug-resistant infections, 17% of them children under five (GRAM 2021), most of the rest older adults (facts: death_ages), times how much Your values weigh a life, in healthy years at the shared rate.

rows.label: Our value of one of Ambitious Impact's GBD DALYs (deaths valued by age), per DALY
rows.formula: @death_ages.amr_yld_share + @death_ages.amr_deaths_per_daly * death_value_in_dalys
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** Ambitious Impact counts the Global Burden of Disease's DALYs for drug-resistant infections: mostly years of life lost to deaths, at GBD's life expectancy, untouched by the value-of-life slider. Our view splits each DALY into the illness part (kept as DALYs) and the deaths behind the rest (37.4 DALYs per attributable death (GRAM 2021)), and values those deaths by age like every death on the site (row above). The evaluator view keeps Ambitious Impact's DALYs (1).

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity advocating for subscription-style pull incentives (the US PASTEUR Act, and similar schemes in other rich countries) that pay for new antibiotics against drug-resistant infections. The idea ARMoR was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and governments' costs ($110). The report's summary gives $90.80 and its CEA section $112, both from earlier versions of the sheet; counting the charity's costs alone the sheet gives $0.12 (the report: $0.10).

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: ARMoR advocates for antibiotic pull incentives, its key ask an EU subscription model (November 2025); AIM modelled the US PASTEUR Act.
